models_evaluated: CatBoost classifier (version 1.2.5) with rule engine (44 patient-specific rules, 1129 drug-drug interaction rules)

links.outcome: Alert rates and pharmacist-intervention yield at two external validation hospitals
links.effect: External alert rates 22.6% (7/31) to 32.1% (310/966); 18.8% (22/117) to 57.1% (4/7) of alerts needed pharmacist intervention; AUC 0.871-0.963; no false negatives identified.
links.quote: In external validation across 2 hospitals, alert rates ranged from 22.6% (7/31) to 32.1% (310/966), with 18.8% (22/117) to 57.1% (4/7) of alerts requiring pharmacist intervention.

unlisted_practices: Hybrid rule-based plus machine learning alert prioritization to reduce alert fatigue in prescription review

screen.reason: The study develops and externally validates a hybrid rule-based and machine-learning CDSS for anticoagulant prescription review, but it evaluates the overall tool performance rather than testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
